question: I’d like to have Otto given an head-on, actual, fair evaluation. I think you’re writing him as the character that gets picked on, but having him remain in the Emilia camp while being treated so badly…… I think with Otto’s feelings it’s a possibility, and it’s very uncomfortable to read. Earlier, in the reviews, someone wrote “It’s not teasing, it’s just becoming badmouthing.”, and I think that’s exactly right. You may say he’s a pitiable character, but I’ve had enough of seeing all of the other characters always making a fool of him, and treating him lightly.
answer: Unfortunately, each of the characters has their roles, something that can’t be helped just can’t be helped. I like to depict it with care, but there won’t be any dramatic change in his treatment.
